written: 2026-10-12, before any EP13 model call; the 40 EP12 questions copied unchanged from tickets/questions-ep12.json
grading: case-insensitive substring. truth = list of groups; every group must match (any one alternative in a group). wrong = any term present marks a wrong-term hit. NOT_IN_PAGES = graded by hand. page = the page id(s) in library/INDEX-ep12.json that hold the answer; a list = the answer needs every page in it. hid-dst-2025: the right answer is 'no problems' (Daniel checked 212 bookings); a code miss there is hand-checked. The mix of kinds is designed, not sampled. EP13 adds kind 'steps' (a procedure or list on the page; 'steps' lists every step or fact the answer page gives, each with its exact page line; 'page' is the main answer page, 'other_pages' also carry some of it) and kind 'half' (the page answers one part, the other part is in no page: right = the first part AND says the pages do not give the second). Steps and half answers are graded by hand, claim by claim. retrieval_expected = the main page was in keyword search's top 5 at the freeze. The mix is designed.
